# FutureStack AI Hackathon 2026

event_name: FutureStack AI Hackathon 2026
deadline: 2026-08-15T18:00:00Z
duration: 48 hours

## About

FutureStack AI Hackathon is a 48 hour build competition focused on applied AI
products. Teams turn a brief into a working prototype and a submission-ready demo.

## Tracks

- Track: AI Agents
- Track: Developer Tools
- Track: Climate & Sustainability

## Judging

- Judging Criteria: Innovation and originality
- Judging Criteria: Technical execution and reliability
- Judging Criteria: Real-world impact
- Judging Criteria: Demo quality and presentation

## Sponsors

- Sponsor: HyperFrame Cloud — use the HyperFrame inference API
- Sponsor: DataLake Pro — use the DataLake vector store

## Submission Requirements

Submit a repository link, a 60 second demo video, and a short slide deck.
The demo must run live and show the core mechanism working end to end.
